params.name: side
params.description: Allows platforms to specify the side of the quote

params.name: underlying
params.description: Allows platforms to specify the underlying asset

params.name: quoted_currency
params.description: Allows platforms to specify the quoted asset

params.name: quantity
params.description: The `quantity` of the `underlying` asset requested in the quote. Exactly one of `quantity` or `total` must be supplied.

params.name: total
params.description: The `total` of the `quoted_currency` asset requested in the quote. Exactly one of `quantity` or `total` must be supplied.

params.name: participant_code
params.description: The participant requesting a quote to buy or sell an asset

params.name: account_label
params.description: The account_label that's used to fund the trade

params.name: withdrawal_address
params.description: The on-chain address where the withdrawal should be sent

params.name: fee_inclusive
params.description:
Allows platforms to specify if fees are inclusive
This parameter is only applicable for requests made by `total`

params.name: spread
params.description: Allows the platform to define the quote spread in basis points

params.name: destination_tag
params.description: The destination tag or memo ID associated with the transaction. If the asset is EOS, XLM or XRP and no_destination_tag is false, then this is required

params.name: no_destination_tag
params.description: Whether or not the specific withdrawal and destination address requires a destination tag. If the asset is EOS, XLM or XRP, this field is required. Note: zerohash requires that no_destination_tag be false for EOS

params.name: beneficiary_participant_code
params.description: The participant benefiting from the quote to buy or sell an asset

params.name: beneficiary_first_name
params.description:
The first name of the participant benefiting from the quote request
        Only applies to individual beneficiaries. Cannot be used along with business_beneficiary_name.
        Note: Redundant if beneficiary_participant_code is provided in request

params.name: beneficiary_last_name
params.description:
The last name of the participant benefiting from the quote request
        Only applies to individual beneficiaries. Cannot be used along with business_beneficiary_name.
        Note: Redundant if beneficiary_participant_code is provided in request

params.name: beneficiary_business_name
params.description:
The name of the the business participant benefiting from the quote request
        Only applies to business beneficiaries. Cannot be used along with first/last_beneficiary_name.
        Note: Redundant if beneficiary_participant_code is provided in request

items.docs: Retrieves a quote for the purchase of an asset and the network fees associated with an imminent and automatic withdrawal of the asset. Exactly one of `quantity` or `total` must be supplied.

Retrieves a quote for the purchase of an asset and the network fees associated with an imminent and automatic withdrawal of the asset. Exactly one of `quantity` or `total` must be supplied in the request body.

Executes a convert-and-withdraw quote. The underlying asset will be purchased and automatically withdrawn. Use the returned `withdrawal_request_id` with `GET /withdrawals/requests/{id}` to track the withdrawal.
